title: Jacent Plastic Colander with Double Handles, Strainer for Fruits, Vegetables, Pasta: 6 inch, BPA Free Plastic, Dishwasher Safe
description:
About this item
INCLUDES: One (1) personal colander in an individual retail package
MAIN USE: Easily strain pasta or wash fruits and vegetables. The small perforations allow water to drain quickly from food and the two handles on either side of the collander help transport it
PERFECT FOR: One person portion control, berries, or small family. Fill with fruits or vegetables for a 100-200 kCal healthy, portioned snack
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: This reusable colander can be hand washed with warm water and is also top rack dishwasher safe
SPECIFICATIONS: Made of BPA free food grade plastic, this colander has a 3 cup capacity
